maya_sales: Quick Q — Acme's vendor team asked for explicit IR windows and sample legal wording for the POC contract. Can @eli_security or @jordan_legal confirm what we can safely promise for Hosted vs VPC?
eli_security: Short answer: we can provide different commitments. For Hosted API (shared infra) we provide operational acknowledgements and updates; for VPC/private we can include tighter timelines and dedicated handoff channels.
eli_security: Suggested standard timing we use internally: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours (business hours), interim update within 72 hours with triage status, RFO/technical report and remediation plan within 30 days. These are SLAs for incident comms, not forensic depth.
jordan_legal: Note: any timeframe in sales docs should be "notification of suspected incident" vs "final root-cause report". Law and customers sometimes require notifications to regulators within different windows — we can't promise regulatory filings unless contractually scoped and budgeted.
maya_sales: Can we put a POC-friendly blurb like "we will notify customer within 24 hours of confirmed data-impacting incidents and provide regular updates until resolved"?
eli_security: Yes, that phrasing is safe if you include "confirmed" and define "data-impacting". For Hosted: our standard practice is acknowledge 24h, updates 72h, detailed report 30d. For VPC (customer-managed infra) we commit to notify within 48h and support post-mortem within 30d — because we depend on customer logs/access for deep forensics.
sam_engineer: Quick technical note: for Hosted, we can attach request-level logs and timeline snippets within the interim update. Full forensic artifacts require retention/support access — add that caveat.
jordan_legal: Sample clause you can use in POC docs: "Redwood Inference will notify Customer of any confirmed security incident impacting Customer data within 24 hours of confirmation, provide interim updates every 72 hours, and deliver a post-incident report within 30 days. For Private/VPC deployments, notification will occur within 48 hours due to customer-managed systems; Redwood will cooperate in investigations and supply evidence as available." Include phrase: "subject to legal/regulatory obligations and availability of Customer-provided access."
maya_sales: Perfect. One more: can we commit to a point-of-contact escalation lane (phone + email) for enterprise POCs? Acme asked for a dedicated on-call.
eli_security: For paid Dedicated/Dedicated+Enterprise tiers we can assign an on-call escalation contact. For free POCs we provide an incident email/Slack channel with on-call routing as needed, but not guaranteed 24/7 phone. Recommend offering a paid support add-on for guaranteed phone escalation.
maya_sales: Awesome — I'll send the POC blurb and Jordan's sample clause to Acme and note phone escalation is an add-on. Thanks! :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident template link: https://internal.redwood/ir/templates/poc-notify (posted) :link:
